collection.title: Honda Accord Tourer 2015 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Honda Accord Tourer 2015 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this Accord Tourer, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
